# FruitSamurai HUD asset sources and license verification

Retrieved 2026-10-13 UTC from each author's official itch.io page using the free "No thanks, just take me to the downloads" flow. No payment, registration, or paid source files used. This project includes only the selected unmodified PNGs listed in `assets/ui/MANIFEST.json`; the original archive paths and SHA-256 hashes are retained there.

## Wenrexa UI Casual Free #5
Source: https://wenrexa.itch.io/free-ui5
Archive: free-ui5.zip (official displayed filename WenrexaAssetsUICasual.zip)
Contents: 717 PNG files across Blue, Yellow and Purple.
License evidence: official page's "Asset license" field states "Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal". The body explicitly allows free and commercial use.

Pack-internal verification: free-ui5/Readme contains product/shop promotional text, not a separate license. No contrary license was found in the archive. The .url file is an unused promotion, not required for usage.

## Wenrexa Assets FREE: UI Casual Game Interface
Source: https://wenrexa.itch.io/uimobile-free
Archive: uimobile.zip (official displayed filename WenrexaUIMobileN4_OnlyPng.zip)
Contents: 226 PNG files. Only PNG is free; paid Photoshop/vector source is NOT included or used.
License evidence: official page's "Asset license" field states "Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal" and the description allows commercial and free projects.

Pack-internal verification: archive contains only PNG files, no separate license document. No contrary license found.

## Hyper Casual UI - Free by MadFireOn
Source: https://swapnilrane24.itch.io/hyper-casual-ui-free
Archive: hypercasual.zip (official displayed filename HyperCasual Game UI.zip)
Contents: 73 PNG files plus HyperCasualUI.svg.
License evidence: official page explicitly labels the license CC0 1.0 Universal and permits personal/commercial projects without asking permission or required attribution.

Pack-internal verification: archive has no separate license file; SVG metadata contains only an empty cc:Work with image/svg+xml format, StillImage type and empty title; it does not embed a different license or rights restriction. No contrary license found.

CC0 reference: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
No attribution is required by CC0. Retaining source credits is recommended for provenance.
The source authors retain any rights not waived by CC0. This notice documents provenance and is not an additional license restriction.
